title: High-Probability Nash Regret for Decentralized Learning in Markov $\alpha$-Potential Games: Episodic and Fully Online Asynchronous Algorithms with Applications to Markov Congestion Games
abstract: arXiv:2609.14959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study decentralized learning of Nash equilibria (NE) in infinite-horizon discounted Markov games under bandit feedback, focusing on Markov $\alpha$-potential games. We develop KL-projected natural policy gradient (NPG) algorithms in two settings: an episodic setting with frozen policies during sampling and a fully online setting in which players receive a single realized cost sample per time step and update their policies asynchronously along a continuing trajectory. We establish finite-time high-probability NE regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$ and $\widetilde O(T^{-2/15})$ for the episodic and fully online settings, respectively, up to fixed approximation terms. Crucially, our bounds eliminate the distribution-mismatch coefficient, which can scale prohibitively with the size of the state space, while accommodating potential approximation, estimation-oracle bias, and transition sensitivity. translated_title: 马尔可夫α-势博弈中去中心化学习的高概率纳什遗憾：回合式与完全在线异步算法及其在马尔可夫拥塞博弈中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究在老虎机反馈下无限时域折扣马尔可夫博弈中纳什均衡的去中心化学习，重点关注马尔可夫α-势博弈。我们在两种设置下开发了KL投影自然策略梯度（NPG）算法：一种是在采样期间冻结策略的回合式设置，另一种是完全在线设置，其中每个时间步玩家仅获得单个已实现的成本样本，并沿连续轨迹异步更新其策略。我们分别为回合式和完全在线设置建立了阶数为 $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$ 和 $\widetilde O(T^{-2/15})$ 的有限时间高概率纳什遗憾界（含固定近似项）。至关重要的是，我们的界限消除了分布失配系数——该系数可能随状态空间规模增长而变得不可接受——同时能够容纳势函数近似、估计预言机偏差以及转移敏感性。我们进一步识别了按状态……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文针对马尔可夫α-势博弈中的去中心化纳什均衡学习，提出了回合式与完全在线异步两种KL投影自然策略梯度算法，建立了消除分布失配系数的高概率有限时间纳什遗憾界，并应用于马尔可夫拥塞博弈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes episodic and fully online asynchronous KL-projected natural policy gradient algorithms for decentralized Nash equilibrium learning in Markov α-potential games, establishing high-probability finite-time Nash regret bounds that eliminate the distribution-mismatch coefficient, with applications to Markov congestion games.
